About the job About the Role In response to rapid growth over the last 12 months, and an increasing focus on Enterprise clients and agentic AI development, SprintSuite is hiring a new Product and Delivery Lead, reporting directly to the CEO. The focus for this role is to bring structure, efficiency and operational effectiveness to the existing product and engineering team, while ensuring best-in-market outcomes for both clients and sales. This role will be a senior technical leadership hire responsible for owning the company's product roadmap and all delivery functions - from engineering and product management through to support operations and complex client implementations. This role is the critical lever for removing the CEO from delivery decisions, implementation involvement and engineering bottlenecks. The role requires strong product thinking to drive a meaningful roadmap, sufficient technical credibility to lead an engineering manager and their team, and the commercial awareness to manage client-facing Enterprise implementations without handholding from the CEO. The right person will be a pragmatist who gets things shipped, a forward-thinker who can plan ahead to meet requirements, and a leader who develops ever-increasing capability and confidence in the team beneath them. What You'll Do Own and publish the rolling product roadmap, prioritised against company strategy and client needs Lead and develop the Product Manager, Engineering Manager and Support Lead In the event of complex Enterprise client implementation projects, own these end-to-end, from scoping and delivery planning through to handover, in collaboration with the customer success team Define and govern delivery processes: engineering cadences, release management, QA standards and post-implementation review Work with the Engineering Manager to balance capacity across product development, client implementations and support obligations Manage escalations from the Support Lead and Engineering Manager; be the final internal escalation point before the Chief of Staff or CEO Represent product and engineering within the business, and when needed, with clients Build, maintain and evolve the implementation playbook as client complexity grows Partner with Sales and Customer Success leads on commercial inputs to the roadmap, ensuring high-value client needs are reflected in prioritisation Make product, engineering and delivery decisions with confidence based on your understanding of business priorities, strategic imperatives and client requirements Over time, build the team and processes that can support significantly higher client volume and implementation complexity, and make recommendations to the leadership about resourcing requirements to do so. What We're Looking For You have a strong product management background with direct experience leading engineering or delivery teams, product discovery, backlog management, and delivery management, preferably within a B2B SaaS environment. Experience in growth startup environments will be particularly well regarded. You’re comfortable in the relative flexibility of the typical startup environment, as you understand that priorities can change and problem solving requires a calm, pragmatic approach Proven track record managing cross-functional technical teams in a B2B SaaS environment Experience leading complex, multi-stakeholder client implementations — comfortable being the most senior internal person in the room Ability to translate strategic goals into a prioritised, executable product roadmap that the engineering team can deliver against Sufficient technical depth to have credible conversations with engineers, review architecture decisions and challenge scope Strong stakeholder management, internally with commercial teams and externally with enterprise clients Experience scaling delivery operations as a business grows, including building process and tooling that outlasts the individual Familiarity with - but not an inflexible adherence to - agile delivery methodologies Confidence in addressing the wider business as a team leader A proven ability to build a positive team culture, and in turn contribute to the culture of the rest of the business by growing cross-functional confidence and respect. About SprintSuite SprintSuite is an all in one business management platform built specifically for mining contractors. We connect field operations, workshop, finance, and compliance into a single system used daily by operational teams across Australia. It's an exciting inflection point in the business' history to join - we are scaling quickly and building AI driven features, dashboards, and workflows on top of a complex operational environment that is quickly expanding out into a significant Enterprise presence. But the product is only half the story. The reason people stay at SprintSuite - and the reason our clients trust us - is the people who show up here every day. We've built a team of genuinely talented people who are also, refreshingly, just real. The kind of colleagues who'll tell you the truth, back you when it counts, and celebrate the wins like they mean it. We assume you're smart and treat you like an adult. We give people real ownership and the room to run with it. And we've worked hard to keep the things that make a workplace worth turning up to: honesty, generosity, and a sense of humour that makes the whole team's day better. If that sounds like the kind of place you've been looking for, we'd love to meet you. Salary range: $140k-$150k base, depending on experience and fit. Hybrid Working: We work together in our Melbourne CBD office on Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, with Mondays and Fridays as standing WFH. coverLetter:
I have spent the last decade building and scaling payment products across B2B platforms, multi-currency infrastructure, and regulated financial services. At Paymentwall, I managed cross-border payouts across 90+ countries, working directly with currency conversion and settlement partners. At Spenmo, I launched a B2B credit product that required foreign exchange capabilities for international transactions. Most recently at Foundation, I designed a stablecoin payment rail that grew TVL to $20M through multi-pool liquidity management — directly analogous to FX liquidity. This is the experience I want to bring to Monoova’s FX product.

Two outcomes stand out for this role. At Paymentwall, I led Mobiamo, the company’s second-largest product, serving users across 90+ countries through partnerships with telcos and payment providers across SEA and Europe. At Spenmo, I built the analytics foundation from scratch — instrumenting Mixpanel across all product teams, introducing Braze for marketing automation, and rolling out feature flags and A/B testing — giving me the data discipline to own an FX roadmap and evaluate new revenue features with rigour.

I am based in Sydney, hold full Australian work rights as a Permanent Resident, and can start immediately. I would welcome a quick call to discuss how I can drive Monoova’s FX product forward.

About the job About Us Hello Clever is building the next generation of payments and loyalty infrastructure by turning every transaction into growth for merchants and instant value for consumers. We're an AI-powered fintech operating across 22+ markets, helping businesses move money in real time and convert payments into measurable outcomes like higher repeat rates, bigger baskets, and smarter customer engagement. Our platform combines local account-to-account rails, embedded cashback and loyalty products, and powerful data intelligence through Clever AI so merchants can launch offers, optimise ROI, and scale faster, all through a single integration. We're also proud to be recognised on the global stage including being named Australia's fastest-growing fintech, top 100 Forbes Asia, ranked in the AFR Fastest-Growing Companies, and selected for Inc. Magazine's Best in Business alongside some of the most iconic companies in the world. The Role Unlock your potential with Hello Clever. We're seeking a curious, consumer-obsessed, and hands-on Product Manager, Consumer AI & Loyalty to shape the Hello Clever app into a more intelligent, rewarding, and trusted consumer product. If you love understanding consumer behaviour, experimenting with AI-powered experiences, and building loyalty loops that create value for both users and merchants, we'd love to hear from you. As a Product Manager, Consumer AI & Loyalty at Hello Clever, you will own product discovery and delivery across the consumer-facing experience, with a focus on the app, cashback and loyalty journeys, AI-assisted personalisation, consumer engagement, payment confidence, and repeat behaviour. You will work closely with Product, Design, Engineering, Data, Growth, Marketing, Customer Success, Support, Compliance, Operations, and merchant-facing teams to make Hello Clever more valuable for consumers while helping merchants drive repeat purchase, loyalty, and measurable growth. Key Responsibilities Consumer App Experience: Improve the Hello Clever app journey across onboarding, discovery, payment confidence, reward tracking, cashback clarity, account settings, notifications, and post-purchase engagement. Consumer AI & Personalisation: Explore and ship practical AI-powered experiences that help consumers discover relevant rewards, understand value, build smarter habits, and engage with merchants in timely, useful, and trusted ways. Loyalty & Behaviour Loops: Design product mechanics that turn one-off cashback into repeat consumer behaviour, stronger merchant relationships, and clearer value exchange between consumers, Hello Clever, and merchants. Product Discovery & Experimentation: Use qualitative research, behavioural insight, funnel data, support signals, and rapid experiments to identify consumer needs, prioritise opportunities, and validate what drives durable engagement. Merchant Value Through Consumer Outcomes: Partner with merchant, growth, and data teams to ensure consumer experiences support merchant objectives such as repeat purchase, conversion, offer performance, customer engagement, and loyalty ROI. Trust, Risk & Operational Clarity: Build experiences that make payments, rewards, refunds, eligibility, notifications, and account activity easy to understand while protecting consumer trust, privacy, and regulated fintech expectations. Metrics, Launch & Enablement: Define success metrics and guardrails, monitor adoption and retention, support launches, and create the feedback loops teams need to improve consumer and merchant outcomes over time. You're a Perfect Fit if You Have 5-7 years of experience in product management, growth product, consumer experience, loyalty, marketplace, fintech, ecommerce, payments, or a closely related digital product role. Fintech or consumer app experience is preferred. Experience working on consumer-facing products, especially onboarding, engagement, retention, rewards, personalisation, wallets, checkout, loyalty, or AI native capabilities. Strong product judgment and the ability to turn ambiguous consumer behaviour problems into clear goals, trade-offs, requirements, experiments, and next steps. Experience with AI-assisted product experiences, recommendation systems, segmentation and experimentation platforms. Curiosity about AI in consumer products, including where AI can create useful personalisation, reduce friction, improve relevance, or build confidence without becoming gimmicky or intrusive. Strong analytical and communication skills, with the ability to balance consumer value, merchant value, business impact, technical feasibility, privacy, risk, and brand trust. Bonus Points if You Have Experience in fintech, payments, banking, loyalty, rewards, cashback, ecommerce checkout, marketplaces, retail media, growth loops, or regulated consumer technology environments. Familiarity with account-to-account payments, PayID, PayTo, wallets, payment status flows, refunds, disputes, cashback eligibility, reward redemption, or transaction-led engagement. Experience working with merchant-funded offers, two-sided marketplaces, partner campaigns, or products where consumer engagement must translate into measurable merchant outcomes. A strong instinct for consumer trust, including clear communication around money movement, rewards value, eligibility rules, consent, data use, and privacy. Why Join Us? High-Growth Fintech - Be part of a company shaping the future of real-time payments, loyalty, AI, and merchant growth. Career Development - Grow your product career across consumer apps, fintech, payments, loyalty, behavioural product, AI, data, and cross-functional delivery. Impactful Role - Own meaningful parts of the consumer journey and help turn everyday payments into clearer value for consumers and stronger growth for merchants. Dynamic Culture - Join a passionate and collaborative team that values innovation, ownership, customer obsession, and execution. We're a small, senior team that values straight answers and doing the work properly. You'll be based at our Melbourne CBD office with a hybrid model, working on genuinely complex custom builds rather than templated websites. We combine innovation, performance, and scalability to build world-class mobile apps, web platforms, AI solutions, and SaaS products for clients across Australia and globally. As we continue to scale, we are seeking an experienced Technical Product Manager who can lead both product strategy and engineering execution. This is a unique leadership opportunity to shape the future of multiple digital products while managing a high-performing software development team. About the Role This is a leadership role combining Product Management, Technical Leadership, and Engineering Delivery. You will own the entire product lifecycle from identifying business opportunities and defining product strategy through to technical architecture, development, testing, deployment, and continuous improvement. Acting as the bridge between business stakeholders and engineering, you will prioritise features, define product roadmaps, write technical requirements, lead Agile delivery, and ensure every product delivers exceptional user experience and commercial value. Gather business requirements from stakeholders and convert them into clear product specifications. Prioritise features based on customer value, business impact, technical feasibility, and commercial outcomes. Create user stories, acceptance criteria, wireframes, and functional documentation. Define MVPs and product release plans. Conduct market research, competitor analysis, and identify opportunities for innovation. Monitor product performance using analytics and customer feedback to drive continuous improvement. Manage the complete product lifecycle from concept through to launch and ongoing optimisation. Engineering Leadership Lead, mentor, and manage a cross-functional software engineering team. Define engineering standards, coding practices, and software architecture. Conduct code reviews and maintain high standards of quality, security, and performance. Collaborate with developers to solve complex technical challenges. Recruit, onboard, mentor, and develop engineering talent. Conduct performance reviews and career development planning. Technical Delivery Translate product requirements into technical specifications and implementation plans. Manage multiple concurrent software projects from planning through production release. Oversee sprint planning, backlog management, stand-ups, retrospectives, and Agile ceremonies. Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and to a high-quality standard. Coordinate internal teams including developers, QA, UI/UX designers, DevOps, and business stakeholders. Manage technical risks, dependencies, and project priorities. Software Development Remain hands-on where required by contributing to production-quality code. Support troubleshooting, incident management, and root cause analysis. Oversee CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure, and deployment processes. Ensure applications meet performance, scalability, reliability, and security standards. Product Quality Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT). Work closely with QA to define testing strategies. Validate new releases before production deployment. Ensure products meet usability, accessibility, and customer experience standards. Stakeholder Management Act as the primary liaison between executive leadership and engineering teams. Present product roadmaps, delivery updates, and technical decisions to senior stakeholders. Communicate project risks, timelines, trade-offs, and priorities. Work closely with clients and internal business units to deliver solutions aligned with strategic objectives. Preferred Skills Product Management experience within SaaS or enterprise software. Experience launching mobile applications from concept to production. Familiarity with Figma and UX principles. Product analytics platforms (Mixpanel, GA4, Firebase Analytics). AI product development experience. Logistics, transport or supply chain industry knowledge. Experience building B2B SaaS platforms. Qualifications & Experience 8+ years of professional software development experience. 3–5 years leading engineering or product teams. Prior Experience in Logistics Proven experience delivering complex software products from concept to launch. Strong understanding of Agile product development methodologies. Demonstrated hands-on coding ability across web and mobile technologies. Experience managing cross-functional engineering teams. Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience. Excellent communication, stakeholder management, leadership, and strategic planning skills. Why Join Wobbitech? Own both Product and Engineering across a fast-growing technology company. Our flexible, secure, and scalable payments platform supports over 100,000 merchants of all sizes across Australia. We help our customers navigate the complexities of the payments platform, enabling them to focus on what matters most: growing their business. About the Role This is a senior, hands-on design role for someone who takes real ownership of complex, high-impact work and builds things, not just specs them. As a Senior Product Designer, you’ll lead research, design and prototyping on payment features, with AI tools as a core part of how you work rather than an afterthought. You’ll turn technical payment capabilities into intuitive experiences merchants actually want to use, and move from concept to testable solution on your own. You’ll work closely with designers, PMs and engineers, joining technical conversations early and shaping decisions rather than designing around them. Your edge is craft, systems thinking and the ability to validate ideas quickly. Key Responsibilities As a Senior Product Designer, your responsibilities will include: Lead end-to-end design for complex payment features, turning technical capabilities into intuitive experiences that merchants actually want to use. Use AI-powered design and prototyping as a core partof your workflow. Tools like Claude Code and Figma Make to build functional prototypes, generate UI variations, and move from concept to testable solution independently. Contribute to cross-functional product decisions. Work closely with product and engineers, join technical conversations early, and help shape what we build rather than designing around it. Run user research and validation. Understand how merchants interact with payment systems, then translate those insights into design solutions that solve real problems. Maintain and raise our design systems and standards. Contribute to our component libraries and set the bar for what good looks like across interfaces, interactions, and the decisions made without you in the room. About You To hit the ground running you will need: Strong foundations in interaction design and UX principles, the kind that help you solve complex user problems and create genuinely intuitive product experiences. Fluency with AI-assisted design and prototyping tools like Claude Code and Figma Make, using them to build, iterate and validate ideas, not just produce mock-ups. Solid high-fidelity UI design skills, with the judgement to know when a working prototype communicates more than a polished mock. Strong cross-functional collaboration, working effectively with product, engineering and business stakeholders. Systematic thinking about design systems to keep consistency and scale across product experiences. The ability to run user research and usability testing to validate design decisions and keep outcomes user-centred. Experience that will support you could include: Fintech or financial services experience, with an understanding of the regulatory constraints and user expectations in financial products. A data-driven approach to design and analytics, validating design impact and informing product decisions. Enough comfort in a codebase to build working prototypes, judge what is feasible, and close the gap between design and implementation. Accessibility and inclusive design experience, so our products work for diverse user groups. A habit of knowledge sharing and supporting team growth. Workshop facilitation for leading design sprints and stakeholder alignment sessions. Motion design and micro-interaction skills that improve the experience through considered animation and transitions. … more See how you compare to other applicants Based on LinkedIn data. tailoredCv.name: Eugene Bochkov
tailoredCv.title: Senior Product Designer | Payments & Fintech
tailoredCv.summary: Product leader with deep payments and fintech experience, designing API driven platforms and merchant facing analytics used across 90+ countries. Built B2B credit products, payment rails, and AI powered features from concept to scale, driving measurable outcomes like 50% faster merchant onboarding and $20M TVL.
tailoredCv.coreSkills: Payments infrastructure, B2B credit, merchant analytics, AI prototyping

bullets: Designed and launched payment rail infrastructure for RWA lending, including borrower vaults and credit order books, growing TVL to $20M and 5k MAU in under a year
Built stablecoin payment system from scratch, managing liquidity across multiple pools and ensuring peg stability
Led product definition and launch of a consumer digital platform, scaling from 0 to 10k MAU and 50k+ digital assets issued within 12 months
Launched B2B credit product (APAC Brex/Ramp equivalent) via banking as a service partnerships, expanding into a regulated revenue line
Built analytics foundation across product org: instrumented Mixpanel, introduced Braze, and rolled out A/B testing and feature flags
Secured early GPT 3 beta access in 2020, designing zero shot prompt architectures and context window strategies before mainstream generative AI wave
Led product and GTM strategy, launching pilots with YC startups to extract meeting intelligence for sales teams
Led global product strategy for B2B SaaS ATS platform serving recruitment agencies, managing cross functional team of 20 and reporting to CEO and board
Led Mobiamo, Paymentwall's second largest product, serving users across 90+ countries with telco and payment provider partnerships (Telenor, Orange, etc.)

coverLetter:
I have spent over a decade designing payment infrastructure and merchant-facing products that scale. At Paymentwall, I led a product serving users across 90+ countries, turning complex payment data into analytics dashboards that merchants actually used. At Spenmo, I built a B2B credit product from scratch through banking partnerships, and I put the analytics foundation in place across the entire product org. That mix of deep payments domain knowledge and hands-on building is what I want to bring to Fat Zebra.

Two outcomes stand out for this role. At Foundation, I designed payment rails and credit infrastructure that grew TVL to $20M and reached 5k MAU in under a year. At Spenmo, I launched Mixpanel instrumentation, Braze, and A/B testing across the product org, making data-driven design decisions standard practice. I also secured early GPT-3 beta access in 2020 and used it to prototype zero-shot prompt architectures, so using AI tools as a core part of the design workflow is already how I think.

I am based in Melbourne, hold full Australian PR, and can start immediately. If the timing works, I would welcome a quick conversation to walk through how my payments experience and design approach align with what you are building.

- Gaps: No explicit mention of AI-assisted design tools (Claude Code, Figma Make) or hands-on UI design/prototyping; lacks user research and design systems experience from CV.

title: Head of Product
description: About the job Watch this! Our co-founder explains why we're hiring for this role now. https://www.loom.com/share/9b47924e664646b4a6ea3127a5d19092 About ProcurePro Mission > To save 1 BILLION construction admin hours. What we do > Our market leading technology helps major builders contract with their supply chain by consolidating fragmented and manual procurement processes into a single platform (currently solved by Word, Excel & email). In The News: Funding → recently raised $15m in 2026, valuing us over $100m (Airtree, QIC, Glitch): https://bit.ly/4tnxuJh 2024 & 2025 LinkedIn Top Startups, https://tinyurl.com/y5eeucww Put on Unicorn watch list of QLDs startups, https://shorturl.at/53yWH Deloitte’s Tech Fast 50 in 2025 - https://tinyurl.com/4p7t72bn Values we live by Better people build better companies Whole arse it, with ruthless pragmatism Help the customer win (We’ll tell you more about these as discussions progress) Key aspects of this role Define and own the product vision and strategy > Set product direction aligned to company goals. Spend the first 12 months deeply understanding the business before reshaping direction. Scale the product org alongside highly involved founders > Partner with founders, who stay close to product, to turn strategy into team-level roadmaps and empower squads to lead their own discovery and proposals. Structure the org for what comes next > Shape domains and squads for execution at double the current team size, and recruit, develop, and retain strong PMs without adding bureaucracy. Drive a high performance culture across squads > Define how each squad measures success and hold teams accountable to outcomes, not feature throughput. Ship high-impact work fast, with quality > Run a disciplined build process that validates outcomes and cuts low-return work early, with Engineering and Design as tight partners. Drive commercial alignment > Work closely with Sales, CS, Marketing, and GTM leaders so product decisions reflect commercial context and market signals. Build an AI-first product and culture > Drive AI adoption across both the product experience and how the team works, championing experimentation as it evolves. You’re ideal for the role if you have… Proven B2B enterprise SaaS product leadership (essential) > 5+ years leading product at $10M ARR+, scaling from 6 to 12+ squads with measurable impact on retention and expansion. Scaled a product org alongside founders (essential) > Grown a product org from ~5 squads to meaningfully larger without adding bureaucracy. Active AI practitioner (essential) > Using AI in your own work today, with concrete examples of what you've built or applied. Product-market fit across geographies > Scaled a product into new segments or geographies using data and customer evidence. Strong prioritisation and commercial instincts > Make hard roadmap calls, defend them with data, and coach PMs toward outcome-focused delivery. Cross-functional credibility > Align Sales, CS, Engineering, and Marketing, and hold your own with GTM leaders and execs. Construction, proptech, or workflow SaaS background is a strong advantage. Our culture Remote First - work from anywhere in Australia - we were remote-first before Covid, have established processes around collaboration/culture to ensure inclusiveness & engagement. Socials - We have regular online social events & hold annual off-sites (in person). Team First - we’re close knit, highly collaborative, actively help each other succeed (knowledge sharing, training) to develop our teams’ capabilities High Expectations - we’re self motivated, embrace velocity as our greatest advantage, take pride in what we do and push to reach our potential. Radical Transparency - we believe in flat structures & sharing knowledge, everyone is privy to what happens day-to-day and nothing is hidden (i.e. company strategy, finances & all). Extra Leave Days - a day off for your Birthday & before Christmas. Extra Annual Leave - we offer 25 days of annual leave. Compensation Salary based on experience Computer equipment allowance to ensure you have everything you need to be successful working remotely How to apply Hit Apply and fill out the form with your information, CV and answer to the question "Why do you want to work for ProcurePro?” What happens next Shortlisted applicants will have an introductory call [20 mins] Successful applicants will have a longer call to get into the details of your experience and nature of the role [1 hour] You’ll receive a short assessment to complete [2 hours] Assessment presentation and discussion call [1.5 hour] Leadership Interview - meeting with CEO and potentially other business leaders [1 hour] If successful, we will check references & make you an offer! Take note: All our interviews are recorded and shared internally with the CEO and hiring manager. We do this so that our team can make better decisions. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, so speed is key. The sooner you apply, the better! If you love the sound of working for us and the role described but the title/salary doesn’t align to your experience, please don’t let that stop you applying. We celebrate diversity and we want people of all genders, races, ages, backgrounds, beliefs, and life experiences to join our team. We complete police checks or the equivalent once you join as part of our SOC2 compliance requirements. You must be based in Australia & have full working rights. Otherwise, we cannot proceed with your application. We cannot offer sponsorship.

This is a hands-on Product Manager role suited to someone with strong product management and business analysis skills who enjoys solving complex problems, working at the intersection of AI, internal workflows and business outcomes, and confidently balancing strategy with delivery. Key responsibilities Contribute to the product vision, roadmap and backlog for Aurora To initiatives, ensuring alignment with user needs, business priorities, and risk and compliance requirements. Lead product discovery to define the right problems, using stakeholder insights, data and domain knowledge to identify opportunities for AI and automation. Prioritise features and enhancements based on customer value, business impact, technical effort and delivery risk. Act as the voice of the internal customer, balancing usability, safety, explainability and operational practicality. Own initiatives end-to-end, from discovery and strategy through to delivery, optimisation and continuous improvement. Discovery, Analysis & Delivery Translate business needs into clear epics, user stories and acceptance criteria, supporting backlog refinement, testing, implementation and release. Document business processes, system interactions, decision logic and key dependencies to support successful delivery. Partner closely with Engineering, Data and Design throughout discovery, development and delivery to ensure successful outcomes. Measure product success through adoption, usage, time saved and customer feedback, using data and insights to drive continuous improvement. Stakeholder engagement & collaboration Build strong relationships across Product, Engineering, Data, Design, Operations, Risk, Compliance and internal user groups to drive alignment and deliver high-impact AI-powered solutions. Use stakeholder feedback and domain knowledge to improve workflows and automation, proactively managing risks, dependencies and cross-functional collaboration to deliver seamless product experiences. Qualifications Proven Product Manager experience in a digital or technology environment, with end-to-end ownership from discovery through to delivery and optimisation in Agile teams. Strong business analysis skills, including requirements elicitation, documentation, user stories and acceptance criteria for complex initiatives. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence and align technical and non-technical audiences. Experience delivering AI-powered products, automation or workflow solutions, with the technical fluency to partner with Engineering and Data teams on integrations, APIs, data flows and solution design. A structured, data-driven problem solver who thrives in ambiguity, measures outcomes to drive continuous optimisation, and confidently balances strategic thinking with hands-on delivery. coverLetter:
I have spent the last decade building financial products and AI-powered tools that solve real operational problems. At Spenmo, I launched a regulated B2B credit product through banking-as-a-service partnerships and built the analytics infrastructure—Mixpanel, Braze, A/B testing—that turned data into daily product decisions across the organisation. That combination of compliance-aware fintech delivery and data-driven product culture maps directly to what the Aurora To team is building.

Two outcomes stand out. At Dirac AI, I designed AI sales automation tools using early GPT-3 access, delivering workflow improvements for high-growth teams. And at Foundation, I built a stablecoin from scratch to $20M TVL and 5k monthly active users in 12 months, managing yield architecture and multi-jurisdictional compliance. Both required translating complex technical capabilities into products that people actually used and trusted.

I am based in Sydney, hold full Australian work rights as a Permanent Resident, and can start immediately. If the timing works, I would welcome a quick conversation to walk through how my experience fits what you need.

description: About the job The Game Changers: Australian Payments Plus (AP+) is here to shape the future of payments for Australia. We aim to deliver more innovation to Australia's payments ecosystem, for the collective benefit of Australian businesses, government and consumers.​ Our solutions include Australia's domestic debit network, real-time, data rich payments infrastructure, secure bill payments, digital identity verification, QR payments and experiences and open wallet solutions. It's a new chapter with more possibilities.​ The Purpose Due to continued internal growth, we are seeking an experienced Senior Product Manager to lead the strategy, development and lifecycle management of our payments products. Working at the intersection of customer needs, market opportunities and business strategy, you will define product direction, prioritise high-impact initiatives and deliver innovative payment solutions that create value for customers and the business. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams and key stakeholders to bring products to market, optimise performance and drive continuous improvement across the payments portfolio. Key Responsibilities of the role: Own the end-to-end lifecycle of BPAY payments products and capabilities, from strategy and discovery through to delivery, optimisation and retirement. Define and execute the product vision, strategy and roadmap, balancing customer needs, commercial objectives, regulatory requirements and emerging payments trends. Identify and prioritise product opportunities using customer insights, market intelligence, performance data and business value to deliver differentiated payment experiences. Partner with Technology, Operations, Risk, Compliance and Commercial teams to design, build and launch secure, scalable and compliant payment solutions. Lead cross-functional delivery teams to successfully implement product initiatives, ensuring quality outcomes, effective governance and timely execution. Monitor product performance, customer adoption and operational metrics, using data-driven insights to continuously optimise products and improve business outcomes. Develop business cases, assess the feasibility of new products and enhancements, and define clear product requirements to support investment decisions and delivery. Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, payment partners and vendors, providing expert advice to influence product strategy, innovation and portfolio growth. You'll be a strong fit for this role if you have: Demonstrated experience as a Senior Product Manager, ideally within payments or banking with responsibility for delivering customer-centric products. Working knowledge of the Australian payments ecosystem, payment technologies, financial services and digital product delivery. Proven ability to develop product strategies, prioritise roadmaps and manage products across the full lifecycle, from discovery and launch through to optimisation and retirement. Experience translating customer insights, market research and business objectives into clear product requirements, business cases and commercially viable solutions. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess business opportunities, evaluate options and make informed, data-driven decisions. Demonstrated success leading cross-functional teams and delivering complex initiatives using agile or contemporary product delivery practices, while balancing competing priorities and risks. Excellent stakeholder engagement and influencing skills, with the ability to communicate effectively, build trusted relationships and provide strategic product advice across technical and business audiences. A passion for innovation, continuous improvement and delivering exceptional customer outcomes. What happens next: At AP+, we believe in the power of passion, pride, and purpose.­ Our team is driven by a shared mission to make a difference in the world of payments, and we're proud to work together towards this common goal. If you're ready to be a game changer, please submit your application. The Talent Acquisition team will endeavour to review your application and notify you of the outcome within the next two weeks. We want to remove all barriers to inclusion so if you need advice or support with your application, we're here to help. Please reach out to recruitment@auspayplus.com.au We also encourage you to let us know your pronouns at any point during the recruitment process. AP+ are not partnering with Recruitment agencies for this role. … more
